caption:
I just found an AI tool that turns simple screenshots into fully animated videos in minutes.

It’s called Bazaar, and it lets you create product demos ,tutorials and more.

I tested it by uploading a screenshot from an app interface, and it instantly turned it into a polished demo video that looked professionally made.

The best part? You can even edit everything just by describing the change, and it will rebuild the video instantly. 

Each prompt adds about a 6-second scene, so you can chain animations to build full walkthroughs, plus you can try it free.

🔥 Comment “ANIMATE” and I’ll DM you the link to access it.
